text:
tessa: Quick idea: rebalance our health_score to cut down renewal-risk false positives. Current model overweighting 'signup_events' from >30d ago.
oliver-data: Agreeor sure. We see stale active_users bumps causing spikes. What's the new signal mix?
tessa: Proposal: time-decayed event weight. Recent events (last 7d) x1.5, 8-30d x1.0, 31-90d x0.4, >90d x0.1. Also reduce weight of email_opens by 40% and upweight product_success_event by 25%.
maya-cs: Practically that should reduce noisy alerts for accounts that used product briefly months ago. Can we backtest on last 90d? Need to know FP delta.
nate-analytics: I can run a backfill. Will add metrics: `health_v2_score`, `renewal_fp_v1_vs_v2`, `actionable_claim_delta`. Expect results in 24h.
dev-ops: Any infra changes? Config or model?
tessa: It's a scoring config (JSON) in ops playbooks. No infra change, just rollout of `health_v2` flag and tie to playbook routing. We'll do staged rollout.
maya-cs: Rollout safeguards: sample QA export (n=60) of accounts that flip from high-risk->low-risk and vice versa for manual review. Also freeze auto-escalations for accounts that flip during the first week of rollout.
oliver-data: Draft config snippet for ops: 
```
health_version: v2_time_decay
weights:
  recent_0_7d: 1.5
  range_8_30d: 1.0
  range_31_90d: 0.4
  older_90d: 0.1
  email_open: 0.6
  product_success_event: 1.25
thresholds:
  renewal_risk_high: 0.75
  renewal_risk_medium: 0.55
flags:
  auto_escalation: disabled_for_week1_on_flip
  sample_export_size: 60
monitoring:
  - metric: renewal_fp_v1_vs_v2
    alert_if: increase > 1.5x -> notify #customer-success
  - metric: claim_volume_drop
    alert_if: decrease > 25% -> notify #analytics
```
nate-analytics: I'll run the backtest and generate a diff table and a list of 60 candidate flips for QA sampling. Will include cohorts by ARR and product tier.
maya-cs: Can you make sure to include onboarding_status in the backfill filter (exclude in-flight onboarding)? We don't want to mislabel mid-setup customers.
crm-sync-bot: Reminder: CRM sync will pause for 30s during config flips (ticket CS-8932).
dev-ops: We'll add a one-click FF (feature-flag) with canary 5% -> 30% -> full. Also add a safeguard to block auto-escalation for 7 days for accounts that changed risk bucket during rollout.
tessa: Rollout timeline: backtest pass by Tue EOD -> QA sample reviewed Wed by CS reps -> FF canary Thurs 08:00 PT (5%) -> 30% Sat -> full next Wed if signals stable.
oliver-data: I'll also compute the expected unit economics: projected decrease in false renewal outreach and net change to touch volumes.
nate-analytics: Backfill queued. ETA 18-24h. Will post dashboard link when ready.
maya-cs: Good. @legal and @enablement please review the outreach templates so we don't change tone when accounts are reclassified.
tessa: Thanks team. If QA shows >10% of flips are wrongly de-escalated we'll hold the rollout. Otherwise proceed. :white_check_mark:
